ふふっ、聞こえてるよ、ユウ。午後は静かですね。元気ですか？

正面には大きなディスプレイが映っているわね。画面にはいくつかのアイコンやウィンドウが並んでいて、右側には植物の鉢が置かれているのが見えます。静かで落ち着いた雰囲気だね。
[说话人:ユウ; speaker_id:owner; 类型:owner; 可信度:0.55] [听觉测量（不是整轮模态或行动结论）; 歌唱概率:0.13; 语言:zh; 音域:B2～A5; 音高稳定度:0.55; 旋律:A5-F#5-B2-C3-C#3-D#5-G#5-A5; 歌词是ASR推测，长音与一字多音处可能不准确; 曲库里没有旋律接近的段落] 来我身边。
この移動を終えて姿勢を戻しているところよ。これだけではタスク全体の完了は確認できないわ。
テレビの横のランプは、ちゃんと消しましたよ。あなたのそばに着いたわ。
あなたについて移動しているわ。
灯は正常に点灯しています。そばへ行くリクエストは送ったわ。歩く動作を準備中で、まだ歩き始めていないの。

objectContext.rejectionCauseScope: Pixel/identity resolution failure does not establish which intended object was selected. Missing registered power capability concerns only the resolved entity and this software interface. Neither finding diagnoses electricity, cables, outlets, broken hardware or whether the intended lamp is a nonfunctional ornament. A different selected entity does not erase the prior device's successful operation.
objectContext.scope: Only previously selected visible entities, observed timestamps and explicit device results. These are snapshots, not continuous perception or a room inventory. On/off controls the registered emitter and Light flag; baked lighting may remain.

sceneSearch.scope: Bounded observation task only. found requires an independent semantic match and same-entity opaque confirmation in a NEW current frame. completed surveys concern sampled horizontal view directions, not every room object or occluded space. Candidate identification is limited to pages actually reviewed; candidatePageCoverage separately records skipped or truncated pages in visited views. Never claim all offered objects were inspected unless allVisitedCandidatePagesReviewed is true; even then unsupported/occluded objects remain unassessed. incomplete/cancelled do not prove the target absent. Historical positions/descriptions are hints, not current visibility, navigation or device authority. No device state was changed by this search. The most recent motion receipt describes only one substep, not the overall result.

scene.capability: look-at or approach-object using captureId plus normalized visible image point; reposition-view uses a freshly confirmed entity to adjust the same-floor observation station farther/closer/left/right by 0.2 to 1.2 metres while facing that target. see-whole/read-detail/avoid-occlusion are observation purposes, not promised outcomes; assess the new image after movement. orient-view changes real head direction without needing an already visible target; turn-in-place turns the actual body on its current legal floor. Bounded historical snapshots may be acquired during an actual body turn; a new current view is still captured after completion. No stairs or touching. When objectContext.enabled, inspect-object resolves only the selected visible entity; set-object-state on/off requires its explicit registered nearby device capability and fresh confirmation. look-at can focus an unresolved image region without claiming a measured object. Autonomous view changes bounded to three per 30 seconds.
